findings.issue: Barrage-held monsters still launched previously queued missiles
findings.reproduction: Real WorldScene.update consumed the held target shot and pushed a Projectile while the barrage was active.
findings.fix: Cancel only this target’s pending missile queue on accepted lock; reject later missile-start events while locked. Existing airborne projectiles and other targets remain.
findings.evidence: before.json / after.json; actual scene browser regression and normal/boss overlap unit cases

findings.issue: Storm weapon chain effects named gwangcheon never aged and were not rendered
findings.reproduction: 12 effects remained at age=0, duration=.3 after6 simulated seconds in real ClassCombatBridge.
findings.fix: Only active barrage effect ID uses controller age; chain effects draw the existing row locally/remotely and expire normally.
findings.evidence: before.json / after.json plus draw/expiry unit case

findings.issue: Cancellation during accepted-hit callback could leave the just-sent remote lease until timeout
findings.reproduction: Unit damage callback cancels barrage before target is added to locked set.
findings.fix: Explicitly release that hit’s remote lease before stopping iteration.
